model_name: Orbital Economy v7.7.7 r1 — Power Resource Capital
notes: v7.7.7: energy-resource extraction capacity is simple capital (a simple_capital node per colony, model/nodes/power-resource-mine.json) in smooth-cap mode: the former uncapped extraction rate is kept as X Power Resource Mine Uncapped Output and capped by the mine capacity; Planet v1 P2 has no exceptions left. See docs/tasks/021-power-resource-capital/.

Modes 0-41 reproduce v7.7.6 r1 exactly (Power Resource Capital Enabled = 0); Mode 42 baseline (A mine grows, B builds up then winds down), Mode 43 transport surge in which colony B rebuilds its power-resource mine and draws its inventory down.
Exact numbers are defined on the canonical platform (docs/VERSIONING_AND_AUTHORITY.md section 8); series-digest.windows.json is the golden.
